verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents an official command-line tool, `fhcli`, but the evidence describes it only for submitting change events (Docker image creation, Jenkins deploys, CI build statuses) from CI or orchestration systems, not as a general interface to the platform. Broader programmatic control is documented only through the API, which uses token-based API keys. Missing for 10: CLI coverage of core workflows (incidents, alerts, runbooks, on-call), any AI- or agent-oriented CLI usage, in-depth CLI reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
